gen-silkscreen-gf-cambay: Wide gaps around every letter give Silkscreen its lo-fi, retro hum. Cambay lands as a modern plain sans, its rounds split open like a cracked bangle and its strokes barely swelling.
gen-silkscreen-gf-cantarell: Lo-fi retro punch: Silkscreen lays letters out like spaghetti, each with space around it. Cantarell counters as an approachable plain sans, with c tips pulled well apart and arches that match their stems.
gen-silkscreen-gf-carme: Silkscreen sets lo-fi, retro letters apart like spaghetti, each with space you can almost feel. Carme is a modern sans with open counters leading outward, a quieter foil for all that spacing.
gen-silkscreen-gf-catamaran: Blunt lo-fi retro: Silkscreen keeps strokes untapered where they meet or end, spaced like spaghetti. But Catamaran is where the curves live, a plain sans whose rounded letters feel unclamped and approachable.
gen-silkscreen-gf-chakra-petch: Space around every letter, almost tangible, defines Silkscreen's lo-fi retro look. Chakra Petch brings a contemporary plain sans with cupped round letters and a stroke that holds one width.
gen-silkscreen-gf-commissioner: Retro through and through, Silkscreen lays letters out like spaghetti. Commissioner takes the opposite route, a smooth sans-serif read with no clogged curves and every stroke at one thickness.
gen-silkscreen-gf-didact-gothic: Didact Gothic reads smoothly, a modern plain sans that never snags on a closed-up bowl. Silkscreen, lo-fi and retro, spaces its letters like spaghetti while the body keeps every stroke at the same visual weight.
gen-silkscreen-gf-dotgothic16: DotGothic16 reads smoothly as a plain sans, wide channels leading into each counter and a tube-like thickness holding through every bend. Silkscreen heads it up, lo-fi and retro, with spaghetti spacing.
gen-silkscreen-gf-doto: Doto reads modern and approachable, with generous mouths on its round letters. Silkscreen, lo-fi and retro, matches it by leaving wide space around every letter, though its ruler-drawn line stays constant-width.
gen-silkscreen-gf-el-messiri: Silkscreen is lo-fi and retro, spacing every letter like spaghetti. El Messiri is a clean, modern sans-serif with a moderate thick-thin ratio and a wide slot between the c's two ends.
